[ 1 ] [ 2 ] It was her second junior Grand Slam singles title. The final between Jamrichová and Jones was a rematch of their 2024 Australian Open girls' singles final, where Jamrichová won her first junior Grand Slam singles title. [ 3 ] Clervie Ngounoue was the defending champion, [ 4 ] but chose not to participate in the junior event this year.
